positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I worked at the interface between scientists and data engineers, developing a web app and in-house visualization library to standardize the visual output of data for multiple scientific domains, increasing the speed and efficiency of data analysis and quality control. I primarily used React, Redux, TypeScript, and d3.js in this position.

Some of my responsibilities included:
- Developing dashboards for analyzing analytical chemistry, proteomic, and transformation data using REST and GraphQL endpoints, increasing efficiency of data analysis and reducing operating costs
- Developing a customizable data plotting library allowing experiment data to be visualized in configurable plots
- Implementing web app authentication using OAuth 2.0 protocol
- Implementing usage tracking and analytics with FullStory and Google Analytics
- Updating GitLab CI/CD pipelines to bundle code and deploy Docker images from Artifactory to AWS
- Wroting end-to-end tests using Playwright to prevent app regressions

company.name: Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard

positions.title: Software Engineer, Pattern team
positions.description:
I worked on a small team of designers, software engineers, and scientists that operated as a design and visualization consultancy within the Broad to help labs communicate data. I acted as a consultant, working in collaboration with multiple labs within the Broad simultaneously, designing and developing portals and visualizations to help each group communicate their data effectively. In this role, I primarily used Vue, React, d3.js, NativeScript, Python, HTML/CSS, Bootstrap, Lucidchart, and Adobe XD.

Projects I've worked on include:
- Integrating a feature viewer into the Genomics2Proteins portal, combining information across multiple data sources (Ensembl, HGNC, RefSeq, PhosphoSitePlus, ClinVar, HGMD, gnomAD, etc.) and generating a comprehensive overview of gene and protein features
- Redesigning and implementing the Drug Repurposing Hub site to surface important information to users more clearly
- Developing code for implementation of the CRISPick user interface to convey the tool's main purpose more clearly and improve user engagement
- Developing a cross-platform compatible mobile app for usage in inflammatory bowel disease clinical trials for the Center for Microbiome Informatics and Therapeutics
- Developing the REST API and UI for an internal web portal used by cancer researchers to study drug resistance
- Developing designs and mock-ups to clearly communicate process workflows and data availability

positions.title: Software Engineer, GTEx Portal
positions.description:
I developed and maintained a major data resource for researchers studying tissue-specific gene expression and genetic variation, performing data extraction, transformation, and loading in MongoDB, developing RESTful API endpoints, and creating/updating portal data dashboards with custom visualizations across multiple data releases. I primarily used Vue.js, jQuery, HTML/CSS, Bootstrap, Python, Flask, MongoDB, GCP

Some of my responsibilities have included:
- Creating a new exploratory visualization tool on the Portal, leveraging the Highcharts charting library to develop a principal component analysis (PCA) plot that links 2 interactive scatterplots, displaying the first 3 principal components for all RNA samples of each tissue
- Improving user security by retiring the old Java login system used on the Portal and updating to a token-based authentication system
- Decreasing data storage costs for the team and limiting access to private files by moving files served on the Portal into Google Cloud Storage, allowing logged in users to download private files through dynamically generated signed URLs
- Connecting data to the front-end using an internal framework to load data into MongoDB and write RESTful web services
- Improving user experience of the Portal, creating collapsible sections on pages within the Portal and standardizing informational tooltips
- Responding to user submitted help tickets

positions.title: Student Worker at Office of the Registrar
positions.description:
• Review and resolve issues for all undergraduate subject departments, including course set-up and registration

• Perform a variety of tasks involving data organization and analysis using Excel

positions.title: Chemistry Head Tutor for Health Career Fellows
positions.description:
• Tutored in group and one-on-one chemistry tutoring sessions, encouraging peer collaboration

• Trained on-call tutors in tutoring techniques and professionalism through instructions and interactive activities

• Helped interview for head and on-call tutor positions, screening for knowledge, approachability, and technique

positions.title: Summer Immersion Program Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Assisted in instruction of 20 high school junior/senior girls in computer science in a breadth of programming skills and languages, including Scratch, Python, Java/Processing, and web development

• Mentored students in developing important soft skills, including collaboration, public speaking, and self-advocacy

• Worked alongside a teacher and an alumna teaching assistant in the classroom.
